en.headline: Happy Valley Racecourse hosts Oktoberfest and Beerfest evenings this month
en.dek: The Hong Kong Jockey Club’s Happy Wednesday series continues tonight with live performances, Bavarian-style food and racing at the racecourse.
body: The Hong Kong Jockey Club is holding its Happy Wednesday Oktoberfest and Beerfest series at Happy Valley Racecourse on three Wednesday evenings this month: 7, 14 and 21 October.

The programme includes racing and live entertainment in the beer garden area. Tonight’s session features performances by Phil D and Joanna Leane. The opening night on 7 October included a ceremony attended by the Consul General of Germany and the club’s chief executive.

Public enclosure admission is HK$10, payable by Octopus at the entrance. Visitors to Hong Kong holding a valid travel document can enter free. Racegoers must be aged 18 or above. Bavarian-inspired food and drinks are available alongside the racing programme.
The Hong Kong Tourism Board lists the events as organised by the Jockey Club at Happy Valley Racecourse on Wong Nai Chung Road.

zh.headline: 跑馬地馬場本月三個周三舉辦Oktoberfest及Beerfest
zh.dek: 香港賽馬會Happy Wednesday系列今晚繼續，設有現場表演、巴伐利亞風格飲食及賽馬活動。
body: 香港賽馬會於本月三個周三晚上在跑馬地馬場舉辦Happy Wednesday Oktoberfest及Beerfest系列，日期為10月7日、14日及21日。
活動結合賽馬及啤酒園現場娛樂。今晚有Phil D及Joanna Leane演出。10月7日開幕夜有德國駐港總領事及馬會行政總裁出席儀式。
公眾席入場費10元，可用八達通於入口繳付。持有效旅遊證件的訪港旅客可免費入場。入場人士須年滿18歲。場內提供巴伐利亞風格飲食。
香港旅遊發展局資料顯示，活動由香港賽馬會主辦，地點為黃泥涌道跑馬地馬場。
